payload.description: A Workcenter is attached to a product Strategy process and defines a physical place where work is to take place. A workcenter has a fixed amount of capacity that can be evaluated if you define this resource type as a constraint. Workcenter Type resources, will automatically receive a corresponding Location - since inventory must be able to be stored and loaded to the resource.

Outside Processors are generally considered a constraint - however, they will no be if not flagged as one. Outside Processor Resource Types are auto-created by a flow, when you setup a new Supplier of Type = Outside Processor. These resources also create a corresponding Location in Fuuz.

Supplier Resource Types are created when adding new component or raw material type suppliers to Fuuz. This is primarily used to define the approved supplier/resource for a particular product strategy process. Supplier Resource Types also allow you to configure an appropriate receiving UI based on the requirements.
